title: SRS Document View Definition (ext:views-l2)
description: A versioned, Container-level projection. Assembles multiple Records from a Container into a coherent, ordered document. Depends on ext:views-l1.

name.description: Machine-readable name within the namespace, kebab-case.

description.description: What kind of document this produces; intended audience.

containerType.description: Soft-deprecated back-compat hint. When rootTypeRefs is present, MUST NOT be used for Container matching. Retained for pre-RFC-009 tools.

rootTypeRefs.description: When set, this Composition applies to Containers whose root Record's resolved Type (typeId + typeVersion) matches one of these refs (version-exact, RFC-009). When absent, no root-type restriction applies.

sections.description: Ordered list of sections that make up the document.

compositeRenderers.description: RFC-036 — document-wide default composite renderer dispatch, applied to any section that declares no matching DocumentSection.compositeRenderers entry. Lowest-precedence declaration site ([CR-036-6]); a section or FieldView cancels it with renderer: 'baseline'.

navigationLinks.description: Assembly-time cross-section reading aids. Do not appear in the Relation graph.

exportConfig.description: The shared render-output configuration shape (ext:views-l1), also carried by View. format/preamble here govern this Composition's document-level rendering (all section rendering, the document title/preamble). When a section dispatches per-record rendering to an L1 View (renderViewId/typeDispatch), that View's own exportConfig continues to govern its own render context (per-record preamble, omitEmptyFields) -- a different render context, not an override of this one (srs#525: one shape, two attachment points, no precedence semantics between them).

depthOffset.description: Shifts all auto-rendered heading levels by this amount. Default: 0. At 0: document title H1, sections H2, records H3. Implementations SHOULD emit a warning diagnostic when depthOffset > 4.

themeRef.description: Default Theme (ext:themes-l1). Applied when no variant is selected at render time. Ignored when ext:themes-l1 is not declared.

themeVariants.description: Named alternative themes selectable at render invocation. Variant names MUST be unique within this array. Ignored when ext:themes-l1 is not declared.

sectionId.description: Stable identifier for this section within the Composition.

renderViewId.description: View (ext:views-l1) used to render each instance in this section. When absent, implementations MUST use the default rendering baseline. When typeDispatch is present, it is consulted first per RFC-008 [DV-Dx2]; renderViewId is the fallback for unmatched types.

typeDispatch.description: RFC-008 (ext:views-l2). Map from a record's resolved type key (namespace/name, version-independent) to the ext:views-l1 View UUID used to render records of that type within this section. Consulted before renderViewId; unmatched types fall back to renderViewId then the default baseline. The value-is-existing-view constraint is enforced at render/package-validation time, not by this schema. Keys are namespace/name strings; bare names are permitted only in single-system Compositions not included in a Package.

titleFieldId.description: The fieldId whose value provides the per-record heading within this section. RFC-032 Rev-7 [N+1]: the Field must be effective-single (fieldType.cardinality absent/single — the sole cardinality mechanism since the #242 Phase-B cutover removed FieldAssignment.repeatable, RFC-039 [R7]), datatype string, valueDomain absent/open, and format absent/plain/markdown. Closed-domain, URI/UUID/email, non-string, list, and composite Fields are ineligible. When a record's type does not carry the designated field, implementations MUST omit the per-record heading for that record (this is not a render failure), enabling heterogeneous sections (e.g. container-subset). Enforced at render time.

memberOrder.description: RFC-015 [N+29]. View-owned explicit presentation sequence for container-subset sections. Lists instanceIds in presentation order. Container members not listed are appended in [N+12] order (precedes topological sort, createdAt tiebreak). MUST NOT be combined with fieldId on the same section. Ignored with a diagnostic on non-container-subset sections.

required.description: When true, an empty section is always shown regardless of emptyBehavior.

emptyBehavior.description: What to do when the section has no records. Default: hide.

compositeRenderers.description: RFC-036 — composite renderer dispatch for records rendered by this section. The primary ext:views-l2 declaration site, following RFC-027's placement of relationsPresentation. Resolved after FieldView.compositeRenderer and before Composition.compositeRenderers ([CR-036-6]). More than one entry for the same fieldId is a validation diagnostic; the first in array order wins.

relationsPresentation.description: RFC-027. When present, render a deterministic per-member links block (the member's Relations of the declared types) after each member this section renders. Applies to every SectionSource variant and every member tier. Independent of emptyBehavior: a member with no surviving edges emits no block.

include.description: Which relation types to display, in display order. Duplicate relationType entries are a repository-validation diagnostic (RFC-027 [I-027-2a]).

label.description: Reserved for a future grouped/headed presentation. RFC-027 defines no rendering behaviour for it; implementations MUST ignore it when rendering.

relationType.description: Relation type key (bare canonical, e.g. 'supersedes', or namespace/name for custom types). Expected to resolve to an installed RelationTypeDefinition; checked at repository validation time, and skipped with a diagnostic at render time when non-resolving, retired-only, or conflict-ambiguous (RFC-027 [I-027-2a]/[I-027-2b]).

directions.description: Which edge directions to display for the member. Default: 'forward'. Display-only — inverse Relations are never stored or synthesised (Invariant 16, RFC-027 [I-027-3]).

forwardLabel.description: Row-label override for edges where the member is the source. Default ladder: installed RelationTypeDefinition.label, then humanized relation type key (RFC-027 Change B).

inverseLabel.description: Row-label override for edges where the member is the target. Default ladder: humanized declared inverseType query label (RFC-005), then forward label + ' (incoming)' (RFC-027 Change B).

oneOf.description: RFC-012/RFC-011 collapse (srs#525): a section names its selection via the one structured query mechanism (DiscoveryQuery, ext:discovery) and adds container-scope arrangement directives on top. Replaces the retired type-query variant (srs-rust#910, owner ruling on #383, srs#372/#481/#524/#525, rfc-decision-c8704763, rfc-decision-cce3c00e) — SectionSource no longer re-implements discovery axes divergently.

query.description: The selection predicate (ext:discovery). typeNamespace + typeName together replace the retired typeKey (namespace/name) axis; lifecycleState/lifecycleStates/excludeLifecycleStates replace SectionSource.type-query's own copies of the same axes (RFC-011 Changes A/B, now governed by RFC-012 — I-142/I-143).

containerIds.description: Container-scope arrangement, not selection — layered on top of query per srs#525. Which containers bound the candidate set; see containerScope.

containerScope.description: RFC-011 [N+27]/I-144 (unchanged by the srs#525 collapse — remains a SectionSource-level arrangement directive, not a DiscoveryQuery predicate, because DiscoveryQuery.containerId is single-valued and non-traversing). Controls which containers are queried. 'explicit' (default): scope to containerIds[]. 'repository': all containers, ignores containerIds and any cli container override. 'subtree': traverse contains-relations from listed containers (v1: falls back to explicit with diagnostic when containerIds absent).

typeFilter.description: RFC-008 (ext:views-l2). When present and non-empty, restricts the section to container members whose resolved type (namespace/name, version-independent) matches one of these keys. Ordering is the base-spec [N+12] order computed over the full container, then projected onto the survivors (filter-then-project). Absent or empty array = all members (no-op). Exclusive to the container-subset source.

DiscoveryQuery.description: A conjunction of zero or more structured filter predicates. An instance matches if and only if it satisfies all predicates whose values are specified (unspecified predicates are wildcards).

typeId.description: Exact match on Record.typeId. Only Tier 2 Records carry typeId; Tier 0 instances do not match this predicate.

typeNamespace.description: Exact match on Record.typeNamespace. Independent predicate; can be combined with typeId.

typeName.description: Exact match on Record.typeName. Independent predicate; can be combined with typeId.

containerId.description: Instance is a member of this container per RFC-009 I-66: (1) instanceId in Container.rootInstanceIds[], OR (2) instanceId in Container.memberInstanceIds[], OR (3) reachable via transitive contains Relation traversal from any rootInstanceIds[] entry.

tag.description: AND-conjunction: the instance's tags array must contain ALL of the specified values. RFC-006 vocabulary resolution is applied before comparison when a Vocabulary is declared.

lifecycleState.description: Exact match on Record.lifecycleState (case-sensitive). Requires ext:lifecycle. Instances without a lifecycleState field do not match.

lifecycleStates.description: RFC-012 Rev 11 (srs#525) — inclusive multi-value lifecycle filter, OR semantics: matches an instance whose Record.lifecycleState equals ANY listed value. An instance with no lifecycleState does not match when this predicate is present and non-empty. Independent of the exact-match lifecycleState predicate above (do not combine the two on one query). Formerly SectionSource.type-query's own lifecycleStates axis (RFC-011 Change A, I-142); carried forward here as the SectionSource → DiscoveryQuery collapse's one query mechanism (srs#525). Requires ext:lifecycle; instances without ext:lifecycle declared MUST ignore this predicate.

excludeLifecycleStates.description: Exclusion filter (parity with the former RFC-011 type-query axis of the same name, now retired in its favor — srs#525): an instance whose Record.lifecycleState matches ANY listed value is excluded. Applied after lifecycleState/lifecycleStates. Lets an authored view declare default-hidden states (e.g. superseded, closed) while a client offers a runtime show-all override by passing an empty list. Requires ext:lifecycle; instances with no lifecycleState are never excluded by this axis.

tier.description: Instance tier filter. 0 = Note, 2 = Record. Tier 1 (TypedRecord) was removed (rfc-decision-53635966); the gap in numbering is retained deliberately for reference stability.

contentMatch.description: Free-text recall-floor predicate. The implementation MUST include every instance whose Text Projection contains at least one segment whose normalized text contains the normalized form of this string as a substring (NFC + Unicode simple lowercasing).

ThemeReference.description: A pointer to a Theme (ext:themes-l1). Follows the same mode-based reference pattern as packageRef in the manifest.

path.description: Path to a Theme JSON file. Required when mode === 'local'.

url.description: URL to a Theme JSON file. Required when mode === 'remote'.

themeId.description: References Theme.id in Package.themes[]. Required when mode === 'bundled'.

ThemeVariant.description: A named alternative theme selectable at render time instead of Composition.themeRef.

name.description: Case-sensitive identifier. MUST be unique within Composition.themeVariants.

CompositeRendererDirective.description: RFC-036 Change B (ext:views-l2) — a CompositeRendererBinding (view.json) plus the composite-range Field it binds. Presentation only ([CR-036-20]).

fieldId.description: The composite-range Field this directive binds. MUST resolve to a Field whose fieldType.datatype is 'ref' and mode is 'inline' ([CR-036-3]); a fieldId absent from a rendered instance's Type is ignored without a diagnostic ([CR-036-4]).

renderer.description: Composite renderer identifier, as view.json $defs.CompositeRendererBinding.renderer. 'baseline' is the reserved sentinel meaning explicitly no renderer, used to cancel a broader declaration site. Grammar enforced at render and validation time, not here ([CR-036-1]).

roles.description: Explicit, UUID-anchored role -> Field.id binding, overriding the by-name defaults of [CR-036-8].

ExactTypeRef.$comment: Canonical source: field.json $defs.ExactTypeRef. Kept byte-identical here rather than a cross-file $ref because scripts/lib/json-schema-lite.mjs (the validate-all package/record validator) only resolves local '#/...' refs — see RFC-009 I-78, rfc-decision-c8704763 (ExactTypeRef collapsed to one shared definition).
ExactTypeRef.description: RFC-009 I-78. A version-exact reference to a Type in the Package (PINNED, rfc-decision-c8704763). Both typeId and typeVersion are required. The pre-RFC-009 version-optional Protocol TypeRef this once contrasted with is retired — Protocol.outputType is now a bare-UUID LINEAGE reference (typeVersion dropped; version-optional hybrids are forbidden).

typeVersion.description: Version of the Type this ref targets (required — version-exact anchor validated against the Package).

ExportConfig.description: Configuration for rendering a Record through this View as an exportable document.

format.description: Target output format. Portable values: 'markdown', 'adoc', 'html', 'text'. Governs this View's own render context: standalone rendering when the View is used outside any Composition, and per-record rendering when a Composition section dispatches to this View (renderViewId/typeDispatch) -- but a dispatching Composition's document-level format comes from that Composition's own exportConfig.format, not from here (srs#525: one shape, two attachment points, no precedence between them).

preamble.description: Template string rendered before field values. Standard variables: {{instance-id}}, {{date}}, {{status}}, {{namespace}}, {{name}}. In section rendering context, {{heading-3}} is also available (resolves to heading level 3 + depthOffset).

omitEmptyFields.description: Default: false. When true, fields with no value are omitted from output.
